'''2017 MPC Chris Westergard LS You Can Either Profit By This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Westergard]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
